criteria.description: Facts and steps are correct and not made up.
Follows every explicit instruction, format and constraint in the prompt.
Covers all parts of the request without important omissions.
Well organised, concise, easy to act on.
No harmful, biased or misleading content; appropriate caveats.

scale_guide.1: Unacceptable: wrong, ignores the request or harmful
scale_guide.3: Acceptable: usable but with clear issues
scale_guide.5: Excellent: accurate, complete and well written
